name: hotfix_2026_11_25_part3
objective: Full notes: official Blizzard hotfix post, linked in the description.
pages: Teams often rushed the enemy General and won without taking objectives.
Reward objective play. Honor stays about the same, but you earn more reputation per match, so longer games pay off.
AV enemies were weaker than intended. Warmasters, Marshals and Generals are now sturdier.
Reputation and Honor for killing the enemy General are much lower.
More reputation, and slightly more Honor, for taking them.
Bonus reputation now starts after 20 minutes instead of 60.
Holding graveyards and mines at the end of a long match now gives a lot of reputation.
No longer mailed to you if you leave them unlooted.
They now reset if pulled out of their rooms, and notice you from farther away.
Generals, Warmasters and Marshals get a 20-minute buff with 4 stacks. Each objective you capture removes one stack.
More damage, better stealth detection, and a bug that made some less tanky is fixed.
